correctness.rationale: All quantifiers and undefined-coordinate exclusions are explicit. Exact sine parity yields the if direction and the stationary-plane restriction. Factoring the 3D determinant produces a nonzero asymptotic coefficient \(2ab^3c^3(b^2-c^2)/(3t^{12})\) in every orthant for \(b^2\ne c^2\), proving a.e. full rank by standard real-analytic zero-set theory. Simple IVT bracketing gives infinitely many nonzero scalar fixed points and infinitely many first-coordinate solutions. The symbolic checker reproduces the two resonance identities and critical Laurent coefficients and passed 200 numerical tests. No finite test is treated as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The original purpose of the map is to add a third dynamical degree of freedom. The theorem exactly delineates the complete resonance parameter locus where that degree disappears in a single step, and shows that every stationary state is then lower-dimensional despite infinitely many actual invariant point masses. The sharp converse distinguishes this from an arbitrary easy special case; the determinant calculation is specific and substantive. The result informs rigorous interpretation of the map's phase-space and Lyapunov behavior without unsubstantiated encryption claims.
